comment: It feels like a turnaround is underway for Theegala after injuries slowed him down last year. Expect another positive step on a course where he finished T7 in his tournament debut.
Innisbrook is one of the toughest tests annually and Schauffele shines when conditions are demanding. Recent results at Riviera and THE PLAYERS suggest he's ready for another trip to victory lane.
If he continues to progress like he has, many will wait to use up his starts later in the segment. However, if you believe in him, now is an excellent time to strike.
He’s your leader in Strokes Gained: Total this season. Can’t fluke that, or the results he’s had already. Plus, this was one of his best showings a year ago. It’s chalk, but for good reason.
Finished third here a year ago before he became the problem he is today. Leads the TOUR in SG: Total and SG: Putting with an insanely high floor.
